about: What a hub answers to each request against fixtures/pages/site. Lay the site out as `setup` says (bun: layOutFixtureSite in apps/hub/src/cli/pages-vectors.ts), serve it as the page context.site with the context below (key, now, epochs, phones from tokens.json), accept the Host context.host over plain http and refuse context.wrongHost, and send each request as raw bytes (a client would resolve the dot segments itself). The response must have exactly this status and these headers, apart from ignoredHeaders. body: null is empty, {file} is that file under fixtures/pages, {page} is errorPages[status].

errorPages.403:
Link expired

Open the page again from Inyon.
errorPages.404:
Not found

This page has no file at that address.
errorPages.405:
Read only

Pages can be read, nothing else.
errorPages.413:
Too big

This file is too big to show here.
errorPages.421:
Wrong address

This hub doesn't answer to that address. If it's yours, add it to INYON_ALLOWED_HOSTS on the hub.
